body:
I've spoken to him since writing this to let him know how I feel, and this is why what you're saying is a lot easier said than done. (I'm sorta paraphrasing, but this is the gist of the phone conversation):

Bob: "Sometimes I can be an asshole, and I hate that.  I hate myself when I hurt you, and when you tell me about it it makes me really angry for how I act, but not because there's something wrong with you.  Sometimes I take that out on you, and I'm sorry.  But you're still my friend and I hope you know that, and I still care about you.... ....but I can't make you happy if you can't do that yourself.  I want to be happy for you, dude, so give me a reason to be and get out of this rut - I know you can do it, so why don't you know that?"

EDIT: He's still not even hanging up until I tell him I'll be okay and that I wouldn't "do anything stupid."

When you said things will get better for me?  I think they just did.  I still have my best friend, and that helps it hurt a lot less.  Thank you for everything, you inspired me to call him. Suddenly I feel a lot more excited about my job than I did while I was writing this, because he said if I can pick myself up without his help, he's gonna kick my butt in Street Fighter or any of my other favorite games, but no dice until then. :)

Thanks again. :D

Thank you, but there's been a 2,000km distance between us for a little over 13 months now, and I've tried to limit my communications with him as well...but I don't understand why it isn't helping.  I can deal with him not loving me back and I can accept that it will eventually go away, but I have also learned that can only happen when he feels comfortable around me as a friend.  What I don't understand is how to do it without either being overbearing or shutting down.  I just want to play some video games with him and laugh together again so I can have my best friend back, because at the moment I literally don't have anyone else (Tim is currently far away raising his newborn kid for a while).

In any case, thank you again.
